metadata.title: Big Tech Earnings Couldn’t Ignite Chip Stocks. What The Semis Need Now.<!-- --> - Barron's

content.text:
Big Tech Earnings Couldn’t Ignite Chip Stocks. What The Semis Need Now.
Big tech’s earnings are usually a tell for chip demand, but this week they came with mixed signals. Now, the market will look to a few events in the coming months to reignite chip stocks.
